_note: Worked example: the author's own install covering the Gulf Coast of Alabama and Mississippi (Oct 2026). Copy to sources.json to run it as-is.

sources.name: Mobile County / City Fire
sources.coverage: Mobile Fire-Rescue main + fireground TACs, county fire, Semmes, Prichard, Saraland (Mobile County P25)

sources.name: Baldwin County Fire & EMS
sources.coverage: Baldwin County fire and EMS dispatch (AIRS 700 MHz). No Baldwin police feed exists.

sources.name: Mobile Regional (KMOB) — LiveATC
sources.coverage: Tower 118.3 · Approach 118.5/121.0 · Houston Center 127.65 when MOB approach is closed. Mount name unconfirmed; LiveATC terms bar redistribution, so this stays listen-only.

sources.name: CSX, FGAR & AGR Railroad — Pensacola
sources.coverage: CSX P&A / PD subs, AGR (160.335 dispatcher); CSX M&M Sub (Montgomery–Mobile) 161.520 when conditions allow. Feed was offline for 92 days as of Oct 2026.

sources.name: NOAA Weather Radio KEC61 · 162.550
sources.coverage: NWS Mobile/Pensacola broadcast. Machine-read forecasts; alerts come from api.weather.gov instead.

sources.name: N4RGJ 147.015 / 146.895 Repeaters
sources.coverage: N4RGJ/R repeaters 147.015 and 146.895 MHz, linked: traffic on either goes out on both. Transcribed; the Jev gate keeps storm/SKYWARN-type reports and skips chatter.

sources.name: George County Law Enforcement
sources.coverage: George County Sheriff (TG 31705) and Lucedale PD (TG 31805) on MSWIN P25 — not encrypted

sources.name: Greene County Fire
sources.coverage: Greene County fire, south tower 154.430 / north tower 155.9475

sources.name: Jackson County Public Safety & MSWIN
sources.coverage: Jackson Co Sheriff, Pascagoula/Moss Point/Gautier/Ocean Springs PD+FD dispatch, county fire, Acadian Ambulance, MHP Troop K, MEMA, Hancock Co Sheriff dispatch, Flight Care (Harris P25 since Sept 2024)

sources.name: NOAA Weather Radio WNG640 · 162.425
sources.coverage: Leakesville transmitter, NWS Mobile. Alerts come from api.weather.gov instead.

sources.name: Amateur Simplex 146.520 / 146.550
sources.coverage: National 2 m calling frequency 146.520 MHz plus 146.550 MHz simplex, Baldwin County area. Transcribed; the Jev gate skips chatter.

sources.name: Harrison County Fire Dispatch
sources.coverage: Harrison Co Fire and mutual aid; D’Iberville, Gulfport, Long Beach, Pass Christian fire dispatch (Gulfport and Biloxi MSWIN sites)

sources.name: Hancock County Fire
sources.coverage: Hancock Co fire dispatch, MSWIN P25 (Bay St. Louis, Waveland, Diamondhead area)

sources.name: Mississippi Gulf Coast Repeaters
sources.coverage: KA5VFU 147.375 Gulfport; W5WA 145.110 Vancleave (Jackson Co ARES); WX5HAR 146.835 Harrison Co EOC. Transcribed; the Jev gate skips chatter.

sources.name: Gulfport-Biloxi International (KGPT) — LiveATC
sources.coverage: Tower 123.7 (also works Keesler). Listen-only; frequency from older listings, unverified.
